literal: When seeing, I do not see faults that are; when not seeing, I do not see other than faults.
translation: When I look at my lover, I do not see any of his faults; but when I do not see him, I see nothing but his faults.
modern: நான் என் காதலரைப் பார்க்கும்போது அவருடைய தவறுகளைக் காண்பதில்லை; அவரைப் பார்க்காதபோதோ, அவருடைய தவறுகளைத் தவிர வேறு எதையும் காண்பதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet beautifully captures the psychological state of a longing heroine. When she is in the presence of her lover, her immense love blinds her to all his flaws, and she sees him as perfect. However, when he is away, her longing and grievance make her dwell only on his mistakes, and she cannot recall any of his good qualities. The contrast between 'seeing' and 'not seeing' highlights how love alters perception based on presence and absence.
